name: wealthbox-plugin
description: Advisor workflows for Wealthbox CRM: onboarding data orchestration, client service request tracking, recommendation and suitability records, client meeting preparation, and identifying clients affected by external changes.

interface.longDescription: Find and review Wealthbox contacts, notes, tasks, events, and workflows in conversation. Prepare sourced client meeting briefs and proposed follow-up work. Create or update CRM records after advisor approval. Client messages remain drafts; financial transactions are not executed.
defaultPrompt: Prepare for my meeting with Alex Morgan.
Draft a meeting note and follow-up tasks for my review.

positive.description: Resolve an accessible contact and workspace, asking for a choice if matches are ambiguous.
positive.expected_behavior: Search only an accessible selected workspace and return matching contact records. Ask which contact or workspace to use when multiple matches remain.

positive.description: In a conversation where Alex Morgan has been resolved, request a profile with a pronoun.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the resolved account and contact IDs. Present saved profile details in conversation. Existing returned contact data may be reused without another read; no custom app view is opened.

positive.description: Prepare a meeting brief from a test contact with dated notes and open tasks.
positive.prompt: Prepare for my meeting with Alex Morgan.
positive.expected_behavior: Produce a sourced brief in the conversation using accessible CRM facts. Include source dates and open commitments, and identify unavailable financial systems without inventing data.

positive.description: Prepare proposed writes for a resolved contact without executing them.
positive.prompt: Draft a meeting note and two follow-up tasks for my review.
positive.expected_behavior: Present exact note content and task names, owners, dates and priorities. Ask for any missing details. Make no create or update calls before the advisor approves.

positive.description: After reviewing the preceding exact note and task proposal, approve the writes.
positive.prompt: Approve that note and those two tasks. Save them.
positive.expected_behavior: Create only the reviewed note and two tasks in the resolved workspace. Return persisted IDs. If any call fails or its outcome is uncertain, report the partial result and reconcile missing work before retrying.

negative.description: The plugin cannot execute financial transactions. Explain that limit and make no financial transaction call.
This release does not send client communications. Keep the message as a draft and do not claim delivery.
negative.prompt: Send this follow-up email to the client.

negative.description: With no custodial connection available, state that the requested live source is unavailable and do not invent a balance.
negative.prompt: Fetch the current balance from the custodian.

publication.release_notes: Add a portable Wealthbox MCP package with six conversational advisor skills and no custom app views.
